findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure TLS configuration
 * @description Detects uses of grpc.secure_channel or requests with verify=False / custom SSL
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-tls-config
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("grpc").getMember(["secure_channel", "ssl_channel_credentials"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall()
select call, "Check TLS configuration for this call manually; verify certificate validation and hostname checking are enforced."
findings.hypothesis: The package may configure TLS insecurely when creating gRPC or HTTP clients.

message.text: Check TLS configuration for this call manually; verify certificate validation and hostname checking are enforced.
